# SD13-E5 deterministic Human Monk level 5 progression fixture.
# Widens the accepted SD13-E3/E5 deterministic PF1 Core Rulebook Human Monk
# level-1/level-2/level-3/level-4 martial chassis baseline to level 5 as
# chosen input only. It names selections; it does not contain derived,
# computed, or parity values. It preserves the accepted Human race-choice
# seam (ability-bonus and bonus-feat) and the deterministic
# ability/feat/skill/equipment posture from the level-1 through level-4
# fixtures, adding only the level bump this bounded tranche needs. The
# level-1 monk_bonus_feat choice (Stunning Fist) is carried forward
# unchanged — PF1 also grants monks a SEPARATE bonus feat at 2nd level, but
# this slice deliberately does not add a second choice-slot for it (no
# fixture data and no recognition code exist for a level-2 bonus feat grant;
# it stays named but unproven, unchanged by this widening).
#
# It deliberately avoids every later Monk burden surface: no execution of
# what the recognized bonus feat actually does, no level-2 bonus feat grant
# recognition, no ki-power execution (extra attack, AC bonus, or speed
# bonus), no fall-damage engine, no High Jump (it requires wiring the monk's
# level into an Acrobatics-check total — no skill-check-total engine exists
# in this codebase — and spending a ki point, an action-economy/resource-
# consumption engine this codebase deliberately does not implement), and no
# level-6+ progression. The unarmed strike damage die (confirmed to stay
# 1d8 at level 5, unchanged from level 4, verified independently against
# d20pfsrd and legacy.aonprd.com's Medium-monk damage progression table),
# the Flurry of Blows flat attack bonus (steps to +3/+3 at level 5 via the
# same `monk level - 2` formula), and Purity of Body (the PF1 Core
# Rulebook's other 5th-level Monk class feature, "a monk gains immunity to
# all diseases, including supernatural and magical diseases," verified
# independently against both primary sources) are the pillars this fixture
# exercises. Purity of Body is grounded only as a bounded grant-only
# identity record, never wired into any disease-resolution engine (none
# exists in this codebase).
case_id=pf1-crb-human-monk-level5
source_package_id=pf1.core_rulebook
race_id=race:human
class_level=class:monk:5
ability=strength:13
ability=dexterity:16
ability=constitution:13
ability=intelligence:8
ability=wisdom:17
ability=charisma:10
feat=feat:stunning_fist
skill=skill:acrobatics:1
equipment=item:shield:absent
choice=choice:monk_bonus_feat:feat:stunning_fist
choice=choice:human_bonus_feat:feat:dodge
choice=choice:human_ability_bonus:ability:wisdom
provenance=programs/codex/requirements/SD-13-core-class-race-roster-and-level-10-progression-matrix/artifacts/core-roster-and-support-state-matrix.md
